diagnosis.cause: Each C++ call recreated a query-only Rapier world and shapes. Paired fresh/reused measurements isolate construction cost; remaining snapshot clone/serialization costs are not eliminated.

limits: One idle query world retained per backend, shared by game-session scope rather than C++ class. Active contexts are not count-limited. Each query still validates its authorized actor IDs, arguments and the per-call128 budget before cloning/installing its snapshot under a serialized queue. No simulation is stepped by this cache.
Cold library initialization, full C++ snapshot serialization and structuredClone remain. Paired CPU/RPC samples are not game FPS, phone thermal/battery or sustained PC120/mobile60 evidence.

Android physical-device verification and iOS compilation/signing remain unavailable without the required hardware/toolchain. Mobile proof executes both portable AOT C++ modules and package backends on this PC.
